map.I_avg = I_active×占空比 + I_sleep×(1−占空比)，即: I_avg = I_active × duty cycle + I_sleep × (1 − duty cycle), weighting the dynamic and static currents by the share of time spent working, in the same unit as the input current (mA).

map.关于「功耗（动态/静态）分析」: About the Power consumption (dynamic / static) analysis
map.功耗（动态/静态）分析是一款嵌入式系统功耗评估工具，输入供电电压、动态/静态电流: The power consumption (dynamic / static) analysis tool is an embedded system power assessment tool. Enter the supply voltage, dynamic and static currents and the duty cycle to estimate the average current, average power and battery runtime, supporting low-power design and battery capacity selection. It runs entirely in the browser and uploads no data.
